boot.noAdminTitle: Your account can't open the panel
boot.noAdminBody: You signed in correctly, but your account is set up as an employee. The admin panel is for owners, admins and managers.
boot.noAdminClockInBody: Use the iPad at your location: enter your 6-digit PIN and pick an action. You don't need an account or a password for that.

auth.setupKioskLink: Set up this iPad as a time clock
auth.invalidCredentials: That email or password doesn't match. Try again.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
auth.employeeNoAccountNotice: Employees don't need an account: they clock in with their PIN on the store iPad.
auth.resetSent: Done. If that email has an account, a link will arrive in a few minutes.
auth.resetSentHint: Check your spam folder too. The link expires in an hour and works only once.
auth.resetRateLimited: Several emails were just sent. Wait a few minutes before asking for another.
auth.resetLinkExpired: This link was already used or has expired. Ask for another from the sign-in screen.
auth.newPasswordSaved: Password updated. You can use it to sign in now.
auth.resetNoCode: This link doesn't carry a recovery code. Ask for another from the sign-in screen.
auth.signOutEverywhereHint: Signs you out on your phone and any other device where you signed in. It does not affect the store clocks: those use their own credential.
auth.signOutEverywhereConfirm: You'll be signed out of this app and every other device where you signed in. You'll need to sign in again on each one.

kiosk.tooEarlyTitle: It's still early to clock in
kiosk.photoNotice: A photo will be taken to verify your entry.
kiosk.savedOffline: Saved on this iPad. It will sync when the connection is back.
kiosk.pinIncorrect: That PIN isn't correct. Try again.
kiosk.pinLocked: Too many attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes or ask your manager for help.
kiosk.forgotBreak: I forgot to start or end a break
kiosk.forgotSubmitted: We sent your request. Your manager will review it.
kiosk.requiredBreakTookIt: I took it, I forgot to record it
kiosk.closeOpenBreakBody: Clocking out will close your break.
kiosk.exitHint: Press and hold the logo for 3 seconds.
kiosk.exitNotManager: That PIN is valid, but it doesn't belong to a manager of this location.
kiosk.exitNeedsConnection: Leaving clock mode needs a connection: the server confirms the permission.
kiosk.setupTitle: Set up this iPad as a time clock
kiosk.setupCodeHint: Ask an admin for it. It expires soon.
kiosk.setupActivated: This iPad is now linked to {{location}}.
kiosk.revokedBody: Ask an admin to activate it again.
kiosk.notSetUpTitle: This iPad is not a clock yet
kiosk.notSetUpBody: An administrator needs to set it up with an activation code before anyone can clock in here.
kiosk.offlineStateUnknown: We can't confirm your status without a connection. Wait for the network to come back.
kiosk.offlineNotReady: This iPad can't validate PINs offline yet. Ask for it to be synced.
kiosk.offlineNeedsReactivation: This iPad needs to be reactivated to validate PINs offline. It works normally with a connection.
kiosk.savedOfflinePending: Saved on this iPad. It will be sent on its own when the connection is back.
kiosk.requestUpdateAskManager: If you disagree, talk to your manager.

admin.nobodyRightNow: Nobody is clocked in right now
admin.nobodyRightNowHint: People working, on break, late or absent show up here.

team.title: Team
team.pinShownOnce: This PIN is shown only once. Write it down and hand it over in person.
team.noEmployeesHint: Add your first employee so they can clock in on the iPad.
team.emailOptionalHint: Not required: employees clock in with their PIN on the iPad.
team.employeeCreated: Employee created. Generate their PIN so they can clock in.
team.noEmployeesForLocation: No employees are assigned to this location.
team.noMatchesHint: Try another name or clear the filters.
team.openEmployeeHint: Tap to open the profile, edit it or generate a PIN
team.pinAfterCreateBody: Once you save, you can generate the temporary PIN and hand it over in person.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.overlapWarning: This shift overlaps another one for {{name}}.
schedule.weeklyLimitWarning: {{name}} goes over the configured weekly limit.
schedule.retroactiveWarning: You're changing a past week. We record who did it and when.
schedule.cancelShiftHint: A published shift is not deleted: it is cancelled and stays in the history.
schedule.copyPreviousWeekHint: Last week's shifts are copied as drafts. Nothing is published until you decide.
schedule.copyScopeAll: The whole week will be copied.
schedule.copyScopeOne: Only that person's shifts will be copied.
schedule.crossesMidnightHint: The shift ends the next day.
schedule.deleteShiftHint: It is a draft: deleting it does not affect the published schedule.
schedule.editShiftHint: Tap to edit, duplicate or delete this shift
schedule.invalidBreak: Enter the break minutes as a number.
schedule.invalidTime: Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 09:30.
schedule.noPublicationsYet: This week has not been published yet.
schedule.pendingChangesHint: While you edit, the schedule is saved as a draft. Your team sees the changes when you publish.
schedule.publishAllConfirm_one: {{count}} change will be published. Your team sees it after entering their PIN.
schedule.publishAllConfirm_other: {{count}} changes will be published. Your team sees them after entering their PIN.
schedule.publishPickerHint: Choose which changes to publish. The ones you leave unchecked stay as drafts.
schedule.retroactiveReadOnly: Only an administrator can correct a past week.
schedule.retroactiveTitle: You are in a past week

timesheet.title: Hours
timesheet.reasonRequired: Write the reason for this correction.
timesheet.approveBlockedTitle: The period could not be approved
timesheet.approveBlockedBody: Some entries need review. Fix them and try again.
timesheet.exportFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
timesheet.manualEntryNoticeTitle: Recorded as a request with a reason
timesheet.manualEntryNoticeBody: Original punches are never edited. Your entry goes to Requests with your reason and stays audited.
timesheet.manualEntryRegistered: Entry recorded. It stays in the history with its reason.
timesheet.noEntriesHint: When someone clocks in on the iPad, their hours show up here.
timesheet.openDetailHint: Tap to see the detail and correct it

requests.title: Requests
requests.approvedApplied: Approved and applied to the timesheet.
requests.approvedNotApplied: Approved. The hours still need to be corrected by hand.
requests.impactApplies: Approving corrects the session and leaves an audit trail.
requests.impactManual: This request does not point at hours on a session: after approving, the hours need to be corrected by hand.
requests.noRequestsHint: When someone asks for a correction, it shows up here.

settings.title: More
settings.kioskPhotoOffByDefault: Off. The app works fully without photos.
settings.kioskSyncStaleHint: This clock has gone longer than your configured limit without syncing. It may be off, without network, or away from the store.
settings.kioskScreenAwakeNo: No — the iPad may go to sleep
settings.allowUnscheduledHint: Lets people clock in without a scheduled shift.
settings.appLanguageHint: Changes this app's language on this device.
settings.codeFailed: We could not generate the code. Try again.
settings.codeShownOnce: This code is shown once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
settings.kioskRevokeConfirm: That iPad will not be able to clock anyone in until you activate it again.
settings.kiosksHint: The iPads linked to this organization.
settings.noKiosksHint: Generate an activation code and set it up on the store iPad.
settings.noLocationsHint: An administrator needs to create the first location before shifts can be scheduled.
settings.noOrganization: We could not find your organization
settings.noOrganizationHint: Ask an administrator to add you to the team.
settings.notificationsHint: They apply to your account in this organization.
settings.notifyAlwaysOnTitle: One alert you can't turn off
settings.notifyAlwaysOnBody: We always tell you if someone tries to clock in from a revoked iPad or one from another store. It has no switch on purpose: it is the signal that a lost iPad is still in use, and whoever took it should not be able to silence it.
settings.onlyAdminBody: A manager can see these settings; changing them is the administrator's job.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 1 MB. It shows on the kiosk idle screen.
settings.logoTooLarge: The image is {{size}} and the maximum is {{max}}. Try a smaller one.
settings.logoUnsupportedType: That format won't work. Use PNG, JPG or WebP.
settings.logoPermissionDenied: Krealo Shift needs permission to open your photos. Turn it on in iPad Settings, under Krealo Shift.
settings.logoUploadFailed: We couldn't upload the logo. Check your connection and try again.
settings.logoRemoveFailed: We couldn't remove the logo. Try again.
settings.saveFailed: We could not save. Check the values and try again.

notifications.activeBody: This device will get the alerts you pick below.
notifications.deniedBody: They are turned off for this app in your system settings. You can turn them back on from there.
notifications.explainBody: We let you know about late arrivals, missing clock-outs, pending requests and clocks that stopped syncing. Alerts never include names or photos: you see those inside the app.
notifications.pendingBody: You granted permission and we are finishing the setup. If no alerts arrive, check your connection.
notifications.registerFailed: We could not register this device. We will try again next time you open the app.
notifications.unavailableKiosk: An iPad in clock mode does not receive notifications. Alerts go to the phone of whoever manages the store.
notifications.unavailableProject: The app notification setup is not finished yet. Let whoever manages the account know.
notifications.unavailableSession: Sign in with your account to receive alerts.
notifications.unavailableWeb: The web preview does not receive notifications. Use the app on your iPhone or iPad.

states.errorBody: Try again. If it keeps happening, tell your admin.
states.permissionDeniedBody: Check the permission in Settings and try again.
states.partiallySyncedBody: Some records need your manager to review them.
states.invalidBody: Check what you entered and try again.
states.noAccessBody: Your role cannot see this. Ask an administrator.
states.notConfiguredTitle: The connection is not set up
states.notConfiguredBody: This device does not have the server credentials. Tell your administrator.
states.notFoundBody: It may have been removed. Reload the screen.
states.offlineAdminBody: We could not connect. We are showing the last data we saved.
states.unexpectedShapeBody: The server's answer was not what we expected. Try again.

errors.generic: We couldn't complete that. Try again.
errors.network: We couldn't connect. Your entry was saved on this iPad.
errors.duplicateEvent: There's already an entry recorded. We updated your status.
errors.invalidTransition: That action doesn't match your current status.
errors.kioskWrongLocation: This iPad belongs to a different store.
errors.concurrentEdit: Someone else changed this. Reload it.
errors.deviceCredential: This iPad couldn't read its credential. Restart it; if it keeps happening, an administrator needs to set it up as a clock again.
errors.notConfigured: This app is not connected to its server yet. An administrator needs to configure it; retrying won't help.

a11y.pinHiddenNotice: Digits aren't read aloud because this is a shared device.
a11y.logoLongPress: Press and hold to open admin options
a11y.countdownRunning: Recording in {{seconds}} seconds. Tap cancel to stop it.
